source.quote: SMSL's own page for the M500 MKIII, read 2026-11-24: « ES9038PRO from ESS Technology »; « ES9311, the noise of ES9311 is as low as 1uVrms »; « XMOS XU-316, true 32bit audio processing, supports DoP and Native DSD, and reaches 32bit/768kHz and DSD512 »; « USB, optical, coaxial support DSD , coaxial and optical support DOP64 »; « Qualcomm's latest Bluetooth chip supports LDAC 24bit/96kHz, APTX/HD, SBC, AAC ».

facts.chip: ES9038PRO (ESS) converting, an ES9311 - which is a low-noise REGULATOR and not a converter - an XMOS XU-316 as the USB interface and a Qualcomm part for Bluetooth. Four ESS/other parts in four roles, and the ES9311 is the exact case that made the chip model need a role per part: it was filed as gustard/x30's converter in the seed data.
